title: platform-objects: the four identity objects declare no `enable.feeds`, so Setup's organization, team, business-unit and user records draw a Discussion feed; declare `enable.feeds: false` (item 1 of objectui#12614)
body:
Filing gate ③: the objectstack half of objectstack-ai/objectui#12614 (filed by the epic PM from the 2026-10-16 Setup review, under the maintainer's 「全部立卡」). It was split by triage at that card's `pm:retriage` (domain:ui seat 3, `6210522260`). The card's own constraint reads: "If the posture must come from objectstack-ai/objectstack's object definitions (`enable.feeds`), the card reports it and files the flag change there." ⛔ Not a claim.

**Reader who acts:** the `domain:engine` seat (`packages/platform-objects`).

## Measured (seat 3's reading, re-read by triage on `origin/main`)

- `packages/platform-objects/src/identity/sys-organization.object.ts`, `sys-team.object.ts`, `sys-business-unit.object.ts` and `sys-user.object.ts` each carry an `enable:` block with no `feeds` key. So they take the default, and the record page draws "Discussion (0)" with a comment composer.
  - Control: the same `git grep "feeds\s*:"` matches `feeds: false` in `packages/plugins/plugin-audit/src/objects/sys-comment-reaction.object.ts`.
- **The console already obeys the flag:** objectui `RecordDetailView.tsx` reads `objectDef?.enable?.feeds !== false` (#2707).
- **The server obeys it too:** `packages/plugins/plugin-audit/src/audit-writers.ts:2226` refuses a comment create on an object whose `enable.feeds` is `false`. Its docblock at `:2214` keeps an existing row readable after the flag flips off.

## The change

- Declare `enable.feeds: false` on the four objects.
- **Pins:**
  - a comment create on each of the four is refused with the existing refusal;
  - a pre-existing comment row on one stays readable (the `:2214` rule);
  - CONTROL: a business object without the flag still accepts comments.

## Grade

**p1 + `target:v18`.** Because the server enforces the flag, this narrows the comment door for four platform objects, and 「REST/数据门收窄亦算」 puts it in the protocol-first class.

## Dedupe

The parent is objectstack-ai/objectui#12614. The four files were read in this act; no open card names `enable.feeds` on the identity objects.
